$comment: Single source for the devcloud CI runner images: what each family is, how it is baked, and
what a fresh image must prove. Read by infra/devcloud/images/check-images.ps1, which fails when
a family is missing (if required), carries the wrong toolchain label, lost a marker from its
description, or is older than maxAgeDays. Nothing here duplicates a version number on purpose -
the marker is the FACT ('flutter ', 'shorebird '), the version lives in bake.mjs defaults, so the
two cannot drift apart. Keep this file and bake.mjs TOOLCHAINS in step: a toolchain added there
and not declared here is invisible to the check.

carries: pnpm store warmed from the lockfile

devcloud-ci-polyglot.$note: No 'uv (astral)' marker yet: the layer installs uv into /usr/local/bin with a shared interpreter dir since 2026-11-25, but the newest polyglot image predates that wording, so asserting it would fail a correctly-baked image. Add the marker together with the next polyglot rebake.

devcloud-ci-flutter.$note: No 'flutter ' marker: image-setup.sh installs the layer (LAYERS="base jdk android flutter") but bake.mjs only names Flutter in the description for the Windows toolchain, so asserting it would fail on a correct image. Measured 2026-11-25 against devcloud-ci-flutter-202611220134. Make the description name its layers, then add the marker.

carries: uv on the shared PATH (/usr/local/bin, not ~runner/.local/bin: a warm workspace runs jobs as `dev`)

devcloud-ci-rust-tauri-win.$note: No 'Windows Server 2025' marker: the newest image predates that wording in the description (fail on the marker would be a false positive on a correct image). Age is what guards this family today.
